section.title: Active learning grounded in real problems
section.intro: My teaching approach combines hands-on problem solving, inclusive classroom participation, and research-informed examples so students can connect technical ideas with real-world applications.

philosophy: Teaching is a dynamic process of engagement and exploration. Learning is most effective when students actively contribute rather than passively listen, so I use questions, practical activities, collaborative problem solving, and projects to bring complex AI concepts to life.

approach.title: Real-world scenarios
approach.description: Use storytelling and practical problems to make abstract technical concepts relatable and applicable.

approach.title: Interactive tools
approach.description: Case studies, collaborative exercises, and guided problem solving encourage critical thinking and active participation.

approach.title: Project-based learning
approach.description: Hands-on projects give students space to explore concepts creatively and apply their knowledge.

approach.title: Accessible explanations
approach.description: Metaphors, analogies, diagrams, and clear visual explanations help learners from diverse backgrounds grasp complex ideas.
